_comment: ROUGH APPROXIMATIONS for planning only. They are not survey data, tax advice or official figures. Edit them with numbers you trust; every estimate the app shows lists the values used.

fx_to_eur._note: Approximate exchange rates (1 unit = x EUR). Update periodically.

benchmarks_senior_cloud_architect_eur._note: Gross annual EUR, senior cloud/solutions architect, [p25, median, p75]. Author's rough estimate from public salary-site ranges; not survey data.

effective_tax_and_social_rate._note: Single person, no children, around EUR 90k gross. A flat rate approximates progressive income tax plus employee social contributions. Expat schemes (e.g. NL 30% ruling) are NOT applied.

living_cost_annual_eur._note: Single person: 1-bedroom rent in or near the city centre plus typical monthly costs (food, transport, utilities, insurance), times 12.
